PoiSuggestion.label: Suggestions de POI
PoiSuggestion.schema: CREATE TABLE poi_suggestions (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, poi_id INT, user_id INT, field_name VARCHAR(100), old_value TEXT, new_value TEXT, status VARCHAR(20), moderator_id INT, moderated_at DATETIME, created_at DATETIME)

PoiDescription.label: Descriptions de POI
PoiDescription.schema: CREATE TABLE poi_descriptions (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, poi_id INT, lang VARCHAR(5), content TEXT, author_id INT, status VARCHAR(20), created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME)

PoiProposal.label: Propositions de POI
PoiProposal.schema: CREATE TABLE poi_proposals (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, title VARCHAR(255), latitude DECIMAL(10,8), longitude DECIMAL(11,8), category_id INT, data TEXT, status VARCHAR(20), moderator_id INT, moderated_at DATETIME, created_at DATETIME)

PoiOwnerActivityLog.label: Logs d'activité propriétaire
PoiOwnerActivityLog.schema: CREATE TABLE poi_owner_activity_log (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, poi_id INT, user_id INT, action VARCHAR(50), details TEXT, created_at DATETIME)

PoiCategory.label: Catégories de POI
PoiCategory.schema: CREATE TABLE poi_categories (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255), slug VARCHAR(255), description TEXT, icon VARCHAR(50), color VARCHAR(10), parent_id INT, order_index INT)
